defects: Uses `dist (f x) (f y)` (real-valued metric distance) wrapped in `ENNReal.ofReal`, but only `PseudoEMetricSpace E` is assumed — `dist` is not defined for a bare `PseudoEMetricSpace` (that structure only provides `edist`), so the statement does not typecheck as given / requires an unstated `PseudoMetricSpace` instance

Even if `dist` were available, `ENNReal.ofReal (dist (f x) (f y))` is not equivalent to `edist (f x) (f y)` in general (loses information when the true extended distance is infinite, and depends on a possibly different metric structure than the one used for `eVariationOn`)
